summary: EyePoint, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a positive recommendation from the independent Data Safety Monitoring Committee for its Phase 3 DURAVYU program in wet AMD. The DSMC recommended continuing the LUGANO and LUCIA trials with no protocol modifications. All active treatment-arm patients reached Week 32; over 35% received a third dose. No deal terms or financial transaction are disclosed. This is a routine clinical update, not a special situation. Watch for mid-2026 topline data as the next catalyst.
